goal.en: Spend one last night out with Mia and Leo, and say what they mean to you.
goal.zh: 和米亞、里歐度過最後一晚，說出他們對你的意義。

background: long empty wooden pier at night stretching over calm water, warm lamp posts along the railing, a bench at the far end, starry sky, distant harbor lights

intro.en: Two days before your flight. Mia and Leo planned one last night out, with a strict "no crying" rule.
intro.zh: 離你的班機還有兩天。米亞和里歐安排了最後一次夜遊，還定了嚴格的「不准哭」規則。

intro.en: One pizza and three ice creams later, the three of you end up at the end of the pier.
intro.zh: 一個披薩、三支冰淇淋之後，你們三個走到了碼頭盡頭。

intro.en: Okay, rule check. Has anyone cried yet?
intro.zh: 好，規則檢查。有人哭了嗎？

intro.en: Not yet. The night is young.

lines.en: So... this is really it, huh? In two days, you're on a plane.
lines.zh: 所以……真的要結束了，對吧？再兩天你就要上飛機了。

choices.en: Yeah. I'm going to miss you two so much. Like, so much.
choices.zh: 對啊。我會超想你們兩個的。真的，超級想。
choices.tip: I'm going to miss you. 直接說出不捨，在好朋友之間最真誠。

choices.en: Yeah. When I think about it, my heart feels very empty, you know.
choices.zh: 對啊。一想到這個，我心裡就空空的。

lines.en: Your heart is empty? Kai, that sounds like a medical problem.
lines.zh: 你的心是空的？凱，這聽起來像是醫學問題耶。

story.en: Leo jokingly checks your pulse. The moment turns funny instead of sweet.
story.zh: 里歐開玩笑地幫你量脈搏。原本溫馨的時刻變成了搞笑場面。

fail.why: 「心裡空空的」直譯 my heart feels empty 在英文聽起來很奇怪。直接說 I'm going to miss you so much. 最自然。

choices.en: Yeah, whatever. It's just a flight. Let's not make it a big deal.
choices.zh: 對啦，隨便。不過就是搭個飛機，別搞得那麼嚴重。

lines.en: Wow. Thanks, Kai. Very touching.
lines.zh: 哇，謝謝你喔，凱。真是感人。

story.en: You were trying not to cry. Mia thinks you don't care. Leo spends the walk back explaining you to her.
story.zh: 你只是想忍住不哭，米亞卻以為你不在乎。回程路上，里歐一直在幫你解釋。

fail.why: 用冷淡掩飾不捨，在朋友道別時容易被誤會成不在乎。勇敢說出來：I'm going to miss you two.。

lines.en: Remember Port Aurora? When our flight got delayed and we were stuck at the airport for hours?
lines.zh: 還記得極光港嗎？班機延誤，我們在機場困了好幾個小時那次？

lines.en: Leo fell asleep on a bench and snored!
lines.zh: 里歐在長椅上睡著還打呼！

choices.en: How could I forget? Best worst trip ever. Leo, you snored like a bear.
choices.zh: 怎麼可能忘記？史上最棒的爛旅行。里歐，你打呼跟熊一樣。
choices.tip: How could I forget? 是「怎麼可能忘記」，用反問句表達回憶有多深刻。

choices.en: Of course I remember! That was the most funniest trip in my whole life.
choices.zh: 當然記得！那是我這輩子最好笑的旅行。

lines.en: "Most funniest"? That's double funny. I'll allow it, I guess.
lines.zh: Most funniest？那是雙倍好笑。好吧，我准了。

story.en: Leo turns "most funniest" into the official name of the trip. It will appear in every group chat from now on.
story.zh: 里歐把 most funniest 定為那趟旅行的正式名稱。從此它會出現在每一則群組訊息裡。

fail.why: funny 的最高級是 funniest，不能再加 most。可以說 the funniest trip 或 the best worst trip ever。

choices.en: Port Aurora... wait, did I ever pay you guys back for the hostel?
choices.zh: 極光港……等等，我那時候的旅館錢有還你們嗎？

lines.en: You did, Kai. Twice, actually. Can we just enjoy the memory?
lines.zh: 還了啦，凱。其實你還了兩次。我們可以好好回憶就好嗎？

story.en: You spend ten minutes going through old payment apps. You find out you owe Mia five dollars. The nostalgia does not survive.
story.zh: 你花了十分鐘翻舊的付款紀錄，發現還欠米亞五塊錢。懷舊的氣氛蕩然無存。

fail.why: 朋友在分享回憶時突然談錢，會打斷氣氛。順著回憶回應：How could I forget? Best worst trip ever.。

lines.en: Promise me we won't become those friends who only like each other's posts.
lines.zh: 答應我，我們不要變成那種只會互按讚的朋友。

choices.en: Deal. Let's keep in touch for real. A video call every month?
choices.zh: 一言為定。我們要真的保持聯絡，每個月視訊一次？
choices.tip: Let's keep in touch. 加上具體約定（every month），承諾才不會落空。

choices.en: Of course! We should totally hang out sometime. Next time, for sure!
choices.zh: 當然！我們一定要找時間聚聚，下次一定！

lines.en: "Sometime"? That's what people say when they mean never, Kai.
lines.zh: 「找時間」？大家說這句的時候，通常意思是永遠不會，凱。

story.en: Mia makes you set a calendar reminder right there on the pier. You can't escape a real plan now.
story.zh: 米亞逼你當場在碼頭上設好行事曆提醒。這下你逃不掉真正的約定了。

fail.why: 英文的 We should hang out sometime. 跟中文「改天約」一樣，常是客套話。真心想保持聯絡，要給具體時間：A video call every month?

choices.en: Of course. We will keep contact always and never lose connection.
choices.zh: 當然。我們會一直保持聯絡，永遠不斷線。

lines.en: Keep contact? Lose connection? Are we friends or a phone network?
lines.zh: Keep contact？Lose connection？我們是朋友還是電信網路？

story.en: Leo starts calling the three of you "the network." It's cute, but Mia still wants a real promise.
story.zh: 里歐開始稱你們三個為「網路」。很可愛，但米亞還是想要一個真正的承諾。

fail.why: 「保持聯絡」英文是 keep in touch 或 stay in touch，不說 keep contact。「失去聯絡」是 lose touch。

lines.en: Monthly calls. And someday, you have to show us Taipei.
lines.zh: 每月通話。還有，總有一天你要帶我們逛台北。

lines.en: Yes! Night markets, bubble tea, all of it!
lines.zh: 對！夜市、珍珠奶茶，全部都要！

choices.en: Promise you'll visit. My mom will overfeed you both, I swear.
choices.zh: 答應我你們會來玩。我媽一定會把你們餵到撐，我保證。
choices.tip: Promise you'll visit. 是熱情的邀約，再補一句具體畫面，讓邀請更真誠。

choices.en: Sure, if you can afford the flight. Honestly, it's really expensive.
choices.zh: 好啊，如果你們買得起機票的話。老實說，真的很貴。

lines.en: Wow. Okay. I'll start saving my coins, I guess.
lines.zh: 哇，好喔。那我開始存零錢好了。

story.en: You meant to be realistic. It sounded like you didn't want them to come. Mia stops planning the night market tour.
story.zh: 你只是想務實一點，聽起來卻像不希望他們來。米亞停止規劃夜市行程了。

fail.why: 朋友說想去找你，先熱情回應，現實問題之後再談。說 Promise you'll visit.。

choices.en: Promise you will come visiting. My mom will cooks so much food for you.
choices.zh: 答應我你們會來拜訪。我媽會煮超多菜給你們吃。

lines.en: "Will cooks"? Your mom's English had better be better than that.
lines.zh: Will cooks？你媽的英文最好比這個好。

story.en: Mia and Leo start a list of things to correct when they meet your mom. You beg them not to.
story.zh: 米亞和里歐開始列清單，準備見到你媽時要糾正的地方。你求他們不要。

fail.why: will 後面接原形動詞：My mom will cook。「來拜訪」說 come visit 或 come and visit，不說 come visiting。

lines.en: A boat horn sounds across the water. Mia sniffs.
lines.zh: 遠方傳來一聲船笛。米亞吸了吸鼻子。

lines.en: Okay, I'm breaking the rule. I'm crying.
lines.zh: 好，我要犯規了。我在哭。

lines.en: Me too. Kai, say something before I completely lose it.
lines.zh: 我也是。凱，快說點什麼，不然我要崩潰了。

choices.en: You two made this whole year. Thank you for everything. Group hug?
choices.zh: 這一年是你們兩個成就的。謝謝你們的一切。來個團抱？
choices.tip: You made this year. 是很溫暖的感謝說法，意思是「因為你們，這一年才這麼美好」。

choices.en: Ha! You both broke the rule. Pay up, rule breakers. Ice cream's on you!
choices.zh: 哈！你們兩個都犯規了。付錢吧，違規的人，冰淇淋你們請！

lines.en: Seriously? THAT'S what you say right now?
lines.zh: 你認真的嗎？這種時候你要說的是這個？

story.en: You get your ice cream, but the moment is gone. You think of the perfect thing to say on the plane, two days too late.
story.zh: 你拿到了冰淇淋，但那個時刻已經過了。兩天後在飛機上，你才想到最該說的話。

fail.why: 朋友已經情緒到位時，用玩笑逃避會讓人覺得被推開。真誠表達感謝：Thank you for everything.。

choices.en: Thank you both for accompany me this whole year. I love you guys.
choices.zh: 謝謝你們這一整年的陪伴。我愛你們。

lines.en: "For accompany"? Kai, I'm crying AND correcting you. Impressive.
lines.zh: For accompany？凱，我一邊哭還一邊糾正你，很厲害吧。

story.en: Leo sobs out a grammar lesson. It's the most Leo thing that has ever happened, but your big moment gets a little lost.
story.zh: 里歐哭著上了一堂文法課。這是史上最里歐的一刻，但你的重要告白有點被淹沒了。

fail.why: for 後面接動名詞：Thank you for being there for me.。「陪伴」用 accompany 太正式，朋友之間說 being there for me 更自然。

lines.en: Group hug! Get in here!
lines.zh: 團抱！快過來！

lines.en: ...Okay, now I'm definitely crying.
lines.zh: ……好，現在我是真的在哭了。

lines.en: The three of you stay on the pier until the last bus, laughing and crying in equal measure.
lines.zh: 你們三個在碼頭待到最後一班公車，笑和眼淚一樣多。

story.en: No one kept the no-crying rule, and no one cared. You made a real promise, and you all intend to keep it.
story.zh: 沒有人遵守不准哭的規則，也沒有人在意。你們許下了真正的約定，而且每個人都打算遵守。

notes.explain: 道別時最直接的不捨表達。miss 是「想念」，不能用 think。加上 so much 更強烈。

example.en: I'm going to miss you so much. Text me when you land.
example.zh: 我會超想你的。落地後傳訊息給我。

notes.explain: 「保持聯絡」是 keep in touch 或 stay in touch；「失去聯絡」是 lose touch。keep contact 不是自然的英文。

example.en: We lost touch after high school, but we found each other online.
example.zh: 高中畢業後我們失聯了，後來在網路上又找到彼此。

notes.explain: Promise (that) you'll... 是熱情的口語邀約，比 You can come visit. 更有感情。

example.en: Promise you'll call me on my birthday.
example.zh: 答應我生日那天要打給我。

notes.explain: 跟中文「改天約」一樣，英文這句常是客套話。真心想見面，要給具體時間或計畫，例如 How about a call every month?

example.en: Let's not just say "sometime." How about next Saturday?
example.zh: 別只說「改天」，下週六如何？

notes.explain: 短形容詞的最高級直接加 -est（funniest、best），長形容詞才用 most（most beautiful）。兩者不能同時用。

example.en: That was the funniest night of the year.
example.zh: 那是今年最好笑的一晚。
